description:
About the job

GoPancham | Full-time | Daily overlap with US/Canada hours

Compensation: $23,500 – $45,000/yr USD (base + retention bonus + commission)

This isn’t a “check in and relay updates” role. It’s strategic growth, and your clients stay because of you.




About GoPancham

GoPancham is an Inc. 5000 agency helping fitness businesses grow through paid social on Meta, Google & YouTube. 200+ active clients, 700+ businesses served, 50+ team members worldwide, 7+ years running.




About the Role

This is not a media buying role. We have a dedicated team for that. You’ll own a portfolio of fitness business owners as their primary strategic partner. A separate team of media buyers, creative strategists, and designers handles all campaign execution. Your job is the client relationship, not the ad account: turning their data into direction and making every client feel like they have a real growth partner in their corner.




What You’ll Do

You’ll own your book of clients, with retention as a direct reflection of how you manage it. You’ll run structured strategy calls back-to-back without losing context between them, and turn Meta and Google performance data into clear direction clients trust without needing to run the campaigns yourself. You’ll build 6–12 month growth strategies rather than weekly check-ins, spot retention risk before it becomes a cancellation, and collaborate daily with media buyers, creatives, and designers without being one of them.




Who This Role Is NOT For

This isn’t for someone whose experience is running ad accounts or campaigns without owning the client relationship. That’s our media buying team’s job, not this one. It’s also not for candidates coming from ticket-based customer support with no strategic marketing input, anyone who waits for clients to raise concerns before acting, or anyone who needs step-by-step instructions for every situation. If “checking in” is your idea of account management, this isn’t the role.




What We’re Looking For
Portfolio ownership: 3+ years as the named point of contact for a real client portfolio, not executing marketing tasks or tickets behind the scenes
Marketing knowledge: Deep enough to lead a strategic client conversation with confidence, even without hands-on campaign execution
Proven track record: Real numbers on accounts managed and retention achieved
Time management: Strong ability to run back-to-back client calls without losing the thread
Communication: A confident communicator clients genuinely trust
Availability: Full-time, with real daily overlap on US/Canada hours

Nice to have: Agency background (multi-client portfolios over in-house), CRM familiarity (GoHighLevel/HubSpot), fitness industry experience.




What Success Looks Like
Retention: Clients stay because they trust the direction you’re giving them
Portfolio health: A full book managed without dropping context or losing ground on any account
Strategic trust: Clients treat you as their growth partner, not a status-update relay




How to Apply

Apply by filling out the form here:

https://hiring.kickstartmyfitnessjourney.com/client-strategy-manager-mx

When you apply, be ready to talk numbers: how many accounts you’ve owned and what your retention rate looked like. No script, no fluff. Just your track record.

About the job

Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

El Customer Marketing Coordinator es el líder estratégico responsable de maximizar el crecimiento rentable y la participación de mercado en el canal de autoservicios, integrando la estrategia de marca, la ejecución impecable en punto de venta y la gestión financiera (GTN). El Customer Marketing Coordinator funge como business partner clave para ventas y áreas comerciales, anticipando tendencias, generando planes de cliente alineados con la visión de la compañía y asegurando que cada iniciativa comercial se traduzca en resultados medibles, sostenibles y escalables.

Principales responsabilidades: 

Definir la estrategia de ejecución comercial por cliente de autoservicios (Walmart, Soriana, Chedraui, etc.), asegurando alineación con los objetivos de la compañía

Traducir planes de marketing y category en tácticas adaptadas al canal, garantizando relevancia y diferenciación en el punto de venta

Asegurar planes anuales de negocio (JBPs) sólidos y alineados con prioridades estratégicas - Administrar y optimizar el uso del presupuesto comercial (descuentos, promociones, trade terms) para maximizar rentabilidad y eficiencia

Monitorear inversión por cliente y por marca, asegurando rentabilidad y visibilidad mensual de GTN: forecast vs. real, desvíos y oportunidades

Trabajar de la mano con el equipo de Key Accounts como socio estratégico, asegurando consistencia entre la estrategia de cliente y la ejecución en punto de venta

Proveer insights, herramientas y soporte en negociaciones clave con clientes para fortalecer relaciones y resultados comerciales

Desarrollar guías de ejecución por cliente, alineadas al modelo de Perfect Store, y coordinar actividades promocionales y planes de visibilidad en tiendas

Medir el impacto de iniciativas comerciales y recomendar mejoras continuas para escalar resultados

Analizar desempeño del canal (sell-in, sell-out, share, margen) y proveer recomendaciones basadas en data para mejorar ejecución y ROI de la inversión

Preparar reportes ejecutivos para Dirección Comercial y Marketing, asegurando visibilidad clara y oportuna de resultados y aprendizajes

description:
About the job

Job Requisition ID #

26WD98585

Position Overview

Autodesk is looking for a Senior Manager to lead the Account-Based and Field Marketing (ABFM) team and accelerate growth for priority industry solutions in the Latin America (LATAM). This person will be part of the leadership team for the Americas geo-based Marketing team that generates demand for our platforms and solutions across key customer segments through account-based motions, field marketing, and partner marketing, with holistic plans that align to the Americas Sales priorities. The Senior Manager role is ideal for someone who thrives on transforming go-to-market priorities into regional marketing strategies and plans, and leading a team to overachievement against pipeline and revenue generation targets.

This role motivates and orchestrates relevant Marketing resources for the regions within Latin America. The Senior Manager directly oversees and supports Account-Based Marketing and Field Marketing Managers delivering marketing sourced impact of key programs and ABM clusters in Brazil and Mexico. The role also coordinates strategic coverage and action plans with Partner Marketing, Brand and Communications, other teams in Marketing and Sales.

The Senior Manager delivers strategic plans for the year for multi-channel demand generation, customer engagement, and pipeline acceleration initiatives; and ensures flexibility to adapt based on quarterly business results and insights. The successful candidate will work closely with LATAM Sales and Technical Sales leadership, Industry and Campaign Strategy, Governmental Affairs, Communications, Marketing Operations, Partner Marketing, and other ABFM teams within AMER Marketing to deliver scalable regional marketing programs aligned to geo priorities and customer buying journeys.

The right candidate is a hands-on team leader, combining strategic planning with operational oversight and support. The Senior Manager will be someone who thrives in a matrixed environment, and is driven to proactive collaboration in crafting programs, events, and other customer experiences that drive increasing amounts of account engagement and deliver measurable business outcomes.

Responsibilities


Partner with leadership across Sales and Marketing teams to plan and oversee execution of regional marketing programs and events aligned to business priorities and expansion growth opportunities across North America
Motivates ABFM team to create and manage multi-channel demand generation across digital campaigns, webinars, Autodesk and 3rd party live events, and emerging channels as appropriate, to drive account engagement and generate tangible pipeline
Adapt global campaigns, content, and marketing priorities into regionally relevant programs that can scale across the North America territories and customer segments

About the job

Visit.org is looking for a passionate and experienced Marketing Creative Lead to join our remote team. The Creative Lead will own our visual identity and creative output, developing campaigns and assets that make Visit.org stand out in the CSR and employee engagement market. This is a senior, hands-on role for a designer who can both set creative direction and execute at a high standard across digital, video, and event formats. The right candidate will have an entrepreneurial spirit, a deep passion for our mission, and the energy and discipline to thrive as a builder in a startup tech environment.

Please note: This is a remote, Mexico-based 40 hr/week contract position that requires working hours from 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST

What Motivates Us

There is room for everyone! We empower each other to innovate and create processes that use technology to generate meaningful, lasting change. We enjoy the challenge of finding solutions to problems that are not a way around it but through it. We're driven by the opportunity to help enterprises and their employees around the world to contribute to their communities.

When You Join the Team


You'll join a movement from the ground floor and a team of purpose-driven people with a strong sense of responsibility, ownership, and pride that we're building this thing together. 
You'll combine passion, purpose, and a paycheck—Visit.org team members get out of bed every day knowing their work is meaningful and has a tangible impact on individuals and communities around the world


About Visit.org:

Visit.org is a women-led Certified B Corporation that designs and delivers full-scale volunteering programs for global companies, with volunteering experiences built with vetted nonprofit partners and rooted in real community needs in 100+ countries and 40+ languages. Trusted by teams at companies like Amazon, Colgate, Paramount, and Cisco, Visit.org acts as an extension of lean CSR teams to run global volunteering that employees love and nonprofits trust.

Responsibilities: 


Develop creative concepts and visual campaigns for events, social media, email, website, sales initiatives, and product launches
Evolve and maintain Visit.org's visual identity, ensuring consistency and a premium brand experience across every customer touchpoint
Design and oversee the production of marketing assets, including social content, presentations, event materials, landing pages, digital ads, and videos
Own the visual identity and creative assets for Visit.org events, conferences, and sponsorships, including booth design, signage, presentations, workshop materials, and promotional assets, delivered on deadline
Sharpen headlines and campaign copy, and apply an editorial polish to AI-drafted collateral so words and design land as one piece
Collaborate with marketing, sales, product, and executive leadership to translate business goals into compelling creative solutions
Bring fresh ideas, design trends, AI-powered creative workflows, and new storytelling approaches that help Visit.org stand out in the CSR and employee engagement market


Requirements


4 to 7 years of experience in graphic design, brand design, or creative roles, with a track record of leading creative work from concept through delivery
Strong portfolio demonstrating campaign-level creative work across digital marketing, social media, presentations, and video (portfolio required with application)
Fluent professional English, written and spoken; this role works daily with a US-based team and creates content for US-market audiences
Expert proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects) and modern design tools such as Figma and Canva
Experience building and maintaining brand systems, including visual identity guidelines, templates, and asset libraries that scale across teams
Strong video editing and motion design skills, with experience producing content for social, marketing, and events
Experience adopting AI-powered creative tools and workflows to increase output quality and speed
Strong editorial instincts: you notice weak headlines and clunky copy, and you can improve them
Proven ability to partner with senior stakeholders and translate business objectives into creative direction
Highly organized and self-directed, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and deadlines independently, with minimal supervision
Experience working with B2B, SaaS, or mission-driven brands is a plus
Experience working in a fast-paced startup environment
Passion for our mission and the desire to make an impact in the world through technology
Must be available to travel as needed to support business objectives. Expected travel may be up to 25% of the time, depending on the role and operational needs
Experience working in a fast-paced startup environment 
Passion for our mission and the desire to make an impact in the world through technology


Please note: This is a remote, Mexico-based 40 hr/week contract position that requires working hours from 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST

Our hiring process includes a portfolio review, interviews, and a short paid design exercise so we can see how you think through a real brief.

Benefits

How we care


Competitive salary, benchmarked at the top of the market
Mission-aligned company events/volunteering

About the job

*EL IDIOMA INGLÉS Y EXPERIENCIA PREVIA SON REQUISITOS INDISPENSABLES*




We are a global organization with operations across multiple regions, dedicated to linking agricultural production with the food and energy industries. Our diverse team works together to support the responsible and efficient supply of essential products worldwide.




As a newly unified company, we are guided by our shared values in everything we do:

 We act as one team
 We lead the way
•We do what is right




We are passionate, bold, and driven. Together, we create value for our customers, for one another, and for the world. With a global presence in over 50 countries, we offer significant opportunities for growth and career development.




Who are we looking for?

We are looking for an enthusiastic and motivated colleague to join our Logistics team as Logistics Supervisor.




Essencial Job Requirements




3+ years of experience in domestic or international shipping logistics
Advanced English proficiency
Soft skills: outgoing attitude, customer focus, sales-oriented mindset, attention to detail, leadership, and strategic thinking
Strong numerical skills
Proactive mindset
Decision-making skills
Excellent communication skills




Job Purpose

You will be responsible for coordinating and planning the comprehensive logistics of grain transportation and storage. This includes the efficient management of port and regional shipments, strategic negotiation of transportation rates, processing and obtaining necessary documentation, and effective oversight of warehouse controls. You will maintain fluid and direct communication with Commercial, Billing, Credit & Collections, and Accounts Payable teams, as well as with suppliers, clients, and authorities. Your primary objective will be to ensure timely, accurate, and fully aligned logistics operations with the company's strategies and the goals of all involved departments.







Key Responsibilities




Supervise and coordinate the daily activities of the logistics team to ensure safe, efficient, and timely execution of operations.
Transportation Coordination: Manage grain transportation logistics (truck and rail), ensuring punctuality, proper documentation, and efficiency.
Warehouse Management: Oversee storage operations, including fumigation, inventory control, inbound/outbound movements, balances, and deposit certificates.
Stakeholder Communication: Maintain contact with phytosanitary authorities, internal/external clients, and service providers.
Supplier Administration: Manage service provider onboarding, rate negotiation, invoice validation, and processing of logistics service payments.
Reporting &, Support: Generate shipment reports for clients and provide support to the billing department and balance reconciliation.
Compliance: Ensure the execution of documented processes in accordance with Compliance policies.
Perform other activities inherent to the department




Benefits

You will work in a diverse team and gain valuable experience within an international organization that fosters the development of your skills and expertise. In addition, we offer:




A competitive salary;
Exciting opportunities to progress your career within our international network;
A professional and stimulating environment
Major Medical Insurance
Grocery vouchers
Saving Found
Dental and vision plan
Life insurance




and many additional benefits that reflect our commitment to your well-being and growth




Location and Work Modality:

Fully on-site from our office in Zapopan Jalisco (Andares).







About our Recruitment values:

We value all applicants regardless of age, gender, race, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, social background, or any other characteristic.




We're already looking forward to meeting you.

You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management challenges that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with strategic accounts, you serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Consumer team owns the Kraken app experience used by millions of traders and crypto newcomers worldwide, the product that turns someone's first crypto curiosity into a long-term relationship with Kraken. We build the interfaces people actually use to buy, sell, manage their portfolio, and interact with their assets. Our stack is React on web and React Native on mobile, and we ship fast, measure everything, and iterate based on real user behaviour. We work agile, globally distributed, and we care as much about why we build something as how we build it.

We're looking for a world-class Senior Frontend Engineer to join our product-minded engineering team: we care about customer problems, measurable outcomes, frontend craft, and fast iteration. title: Analyst, Program Content Operations
description:
About the job

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are… 

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

Your New Role:

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Specialist, Global Distribution Operations, to join our organization.

The ideal candidate will play a key role in the end-to-end delivery of content to protect the best-in-class experience for our user base and drive operational efficiencies in a complex matrixed organization. The Analyst will collaborate with cross-functional departments to ensure the successful delivery and on-time publishing of content to our many distribution points and mirror the speed of scale required for the company.

The goal is to track and escalate any issues with content and work with resolver teams to ensure successful delivery and on-time publishing to our distribution points. The candidate will evaluate and refine existing processes to enhance operational efficiency across the media supply chain. The candidate must thrive in a deadline-driven environment, able to deftly navigate complex matrices of toolsets, teams and technolog

Your Role Accountabilities:

On- Time Publishing Operations
● Track content component delivery (Artwork, Metadata, Video, Global Localization) to ensure accuracy and monitor progress until successfully delivered and published to the distribution point
● Identify, escalate and monitor resolution of component delivery issues alongside resolver teams and cross-functional stakeholders
● Track content fulfillment findings, forecast trends, and identify operational hurdles and dependencies to improve content operational processes
●Contribute to post-mortems, case-studies and other exercises designed to drive improvements to on-time content access and customer experience across global distribution partners
● Adopt and embrace new operational projects and technology features, including following complex runbooks and procedures

General Content Operations
● Other duties may be required, as needed, involving overall project management related to on-time publishing, content QA, content scheduling, localization processing, rights availability tracking and more

Qualifications & Experiences:
● Bachelor's degree in business administration or a related field. Master’s degree is a plus.
● 2+ years experience in multimedia QC/QA, content publishing, project or program management, business, DTC or content operations, or a related field
● Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels
● Exceptional problem-solving and critical-thinking skills
● Self-starter who thrives in deadline-driven environments




How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, union status, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

Asegurar la actualización continua de contenidos y rutas de aprendizaje alineadas a la evolución del negocio y del portafolio comercial.

Priorizar iniciativas orientadas a acelerar adopción de productos, efectividad comercial y productividad.

Coordinar iniciativas de onboarding y entrenamiento comercial alineadas a las prioridades estratégicas del negocio.

Nuevos productos.

Funcionalidades.

Servicios.

Procesos comerciales.

Herramientas tecnológicas.

Cambios regulatorios o estratégicos.

Coordinar lanzamientos comerciales con Producto, Marketing, Operaciones y áreas comerciales, asegurando una bajada estructurada y oportuna de conocimiento.

Métricas de desempeño comercial.

Alinear mensajes, productos y narrativa comercial.

Garantizar coherencia entre capacitación, comunicación interna y ejecución en campo.

Facilitar la correcta comunicación e implementación de estrategia.

description:
About the job

💸 Up to USD 28,000 salary on a full time, contractor contract

🌎 Fully remote working!

✨ Working with globally recognisable brands in US Entertainment

💻 Working with the latest hardware, tech stack and tools

🏋️ Access to benefits (country dependent 🌎 )




Who We Are 




At Storm Ideas, we supercharge the digital presence of some of the biggest names in US TV and entertainment. Since 2008, our international team has delivered bold, forward-thinking solutions for globally recognised clients.




Whether we're building innovative products, producing high-impact social content, or designing smarter ways for our partners to work—we’re right at the cutting edge of creativity, technology, and automation.




Embracing Future-Facing Technology 




Emerging technologies like Artificial Intelligence present exciting opportunities for us and our clients. As the world adapts, we’re committed to safely exploring the potential advantages of AI, integrating it thoughtfully into our work where possible, and one day guiding our clients through new possibilities when they’re open and ready for them. By tapping into our creativity, expertise, and collaboration, we aim to embrace its potential together. Our vision relies on people who are curious about this technology and excited to take on this challenge!




RESPONSIBILITIES 




Storm Ideas partners with some of the world's most recognisable media and entertainment brands. Behind that work are planning processes, approvals, asset handoffs, reporting needs, stakeholder reviews, and internal systems that need to run cleanly.




As a Creative Operations Officer, you will help teams turn messy creative and operational processes into clear workflows, systems, documentation, and handoffs. This is not a generic coordinator role. The focus is reliable delivery: understanding how work really moves, structuring it clearly, building practical Airtable and lightweight workflow solutions, and helping people use them.




You do not need to come from a social media background. You do need to be comfortable learning new domains quickly, asking good questions, and using tools and AI to make your work clearer, faster, and easier to hand over.




What can you expect? 

Organize and manage your own work across briefs, tasks, priorities, and follow-ups, without needing every next step spelled out.
Deliver work cleanly, independently, and on time, with clear status updates.
Map messy processes, identify bottlenecks, and turn ambiguous briefs into clear next steps.
Use AI responsibly to speed up workflow mapping, documentation, QA, data cleanup, and automation support, while checking outputs carefully.
Clean up creative approval workflows so teams know what is planned, what is waiting for review, what is approved, and who owns the next action.
Structure work into sensible fields, statuses, ownership, handoffs, review points, and definitions of done.
Build Airtable bases, views, and interfaces for client teams, with supporting documentation that makes the workflow easy to use.
Improve lightweight systems in tools such as Airtable, spreadsheets, project management platforms, documentation tools, Slack or Teams workflows, and automation platforms.
Create clear documentation, SOPs, interface notes, handover materials, and client-ready explanations.
QA your own work before handoff, checking data, logic, copy, statuses, permissions, assumptions, and user experience.
Present process improvements in clear, non-technical language to internal teams and client stakeholders.
Collaborate with creative, social, client service, analytics, and technical colleagues to ship practical improvements.
Support workflows after launch by gathering feedback, fixing friction points, and improving adoption.




QUALIFICATIONS 




What's important to us: 

Experience taking ownership of workflows, processes, systems, or operational projects and making them clearer or more reliable.
Strong structured thinking: you can break a messy problem into users, inputs, outputs, statuses, handoffs, risks, and decisions.
Practical AI use in real work, improving workflow efficiency and measuring success with KPIs.
Reliable ownership of defined projects, including asking clarifying questions, communicating progress, and escalating early when something is blocked.
Excellent written communication and documentation skills.
Confidence with spreadsheets, structured data, project tools, and documentation tools.
Strong no/low-code and systems aptitude. Airtable experience is highly useful, and this role will suit someone who enjoys turning a rough workflow into a clean working process.
High attention to detail and a habit of checking work before it reaches other people.
Comfortable explaining systems, process changes, and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
Adaptability and curiosity about new tools, especially where they make delivery cleaner or faster.




What’s nice to have: 

Experience with creative, content, social, campaign, approval, or asset workflows.
Experience building Airtable bases, interfaces, automations, or similar lightweight project management workflows.
Familiarity with tools such as Asana, Monday.com, Jira, Zapier, ChatGPT/Codex, Claude/Cowork, Slack, Teams, etc.
Basic familiarity with JavaScript, HTML, APIs, or scripting concepts.
Experience with change management- helping teams adopt a new process or tool without creating unnecessary complexity.




What It’s Like to Work Here




Cutting-Edge Tools & Tech

Work with the latest hardware and software so you're always set up to succeed.




Ideas Welcome, Always

We don’t just say we’re open to ideas—we act on them. Your insights can shape how we work across the company.




Fast, Agile, Adaptive

We move like a start-up but with the backing of a larger team. Quick decisions and a responsive culture are the norm.




Incredible Team, Global Reach

Join an international crew of 175+ passionate, talented people. We hire for skill, drive, and authenticity—just be yourself.




APPLICATION




Please include a cover letter with your application. It does not need to be long, but it should give us clear evidence of how you work.




In your cover letter, please briefly cover:




one example of a messy workflow, process, or system you helped make clearer, including what changed and what improved;
your experience with Airtable or similar lightweight project/workflow tools, including what you have built or improved;
one practical example of how you use AI in your work, including how you check or apply the output.




RECRUITMENT PROCESS




First, we will review your CV and cover letter for the requested examples.




If successful, you will receive a task using a provided Airtable base. We will ask you to show how you structure the workflow, build useful views or interfaces, document your decisions, and explain your approach.




If successful, you will be invited to a 60-minute interview. During the meeting, you will walk through your completed task as if presenting to a client, followed by a Q&A with Creative Operations management.




And that’s it!

Implementar campañas y acciones proactivas dirigidas a reducir el churn, detectando y abordando señales tempranas de descontento o desuso de la plataforma.

description:
About the job

Join the wave of growth at Maersk! We're not just a company, we're a movement. With a vision larger than the ocean, we're on a mission to connect and simplify our customers' supply chains as a true integrator of container logistics. And we need talented individuals like you to make it happen!

2 years of growth, and we're just getting started! Our Global Service Center (GSC) in Mexico has been thriving, and we're taking it to the next level. As part of our GSC Americas team, you'll be at the forefront of driving excellence across our global network, collaborating with diverse professionals, and embracing challenges that inspire growth. If you're ready to propel your career with a world leader in transport and logistics, Maersk is your destination. Embark on a journey with us—where your passion will navigate the future of global commerce.

Here’s the Deal

The Container Sales Customer Experience team manages a team involved in the outfleet of old and total loss containers, selling them globally in over 70 countries. Responsibilities include handling after-sales activities, ensuring compliance with regulations, managing financial transactions, and addressing customer queries. The role requires seamless communication and coordination with stakeholders, training new joiners, driving process improvements and participating in business reviews. Strong analytical skills for handling large datasets and continuous self-development, especially in learning new technologies like Microsoft tools, are essential for success.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Focus & Stakeholder Support


Deliver friendly and professional customer service to internal and external stakeholders.
Respond to customer inquiries via email, phone, or chat, ensuring timely and accurate resolution.
Support the maintenance and updating of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) in collaboration with the compliance team.
Assist in identifying areas for improving customer experience and service quality.
Participate in customer onboarding and implementation support activities.
Join regular calls with customers and internal teams to review service performance and gather feedback.


Data Awareness & Reporting


Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and service requests.
Assist in preparing basic reports and summaries using Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Learn to work with customer data to identify common issues and suggest improvements.
Exposure to tools like Power BI, Power Automate, and SQL is a plus, but not mandatory.


Team Collaboration


Work closely with team members to ensure smooth service delivery.
Share learnings and best practices with peers.
Participate in team meetings and engagement activities.


Operational Support


Support after-sales processes related to container delivery and order fulfillment.
Coordinate with depots and terminals to track and follow up on container movements.
Help resolve basic issues related to delays or documentation.
Escalate process improvement ideas to the relevant teams.

Instead of the traditional agency model with a single account manager, clients get a niche-specific growth pod — specialists across media, funnels, creative, and tracking, all aligned around one outcome: growth. The approach treats marketing as revenue infrastructure, not brand awareness — every dollar tracked, tested, and optimized for real performance, with platform-native strategy for Meta, TikTok, and Pinterest, and real-time attribution from spend to sale to LTV.




About the Role

We're a full-service ad agency partnering with marketing, e-commerce, and D2C brands to build campaigns that actually move the needle. We're looking for a Creative Strategist who can sit at the intersection of insight and idea — translating client business problems into sharp creative briefs, and pressure-testing creative work against strategic intent before it ever reaches a client.

This is a full-time, fully remote position open to local candidates, with compensation paid in USD — offering above-market pay for the local market.

You'll work across multiple client accounts simultaneously, partnering closely with creative, media, and account teams to ensure every campaign is grounded in a clear strategic point of view.




What You'll Do

Develop creative and communication strategies for clients across marketing, e-commerce, and D2C verticals

What We're Looking For

2+ years of experience in creative/brand strategy, preferably within an agency environment
Proven experience working with e-commerce, D2C, or performance-driven marketing clients
Strong storytelling and presentation skills — comfortable pitching directly to clients and leadership
Sharp analytical ability paired with genuine creative instinct
Experience writing creative briefs that creative teams actually want to work from
Familiarity with social/digital platforms, content trends, and performance marketing fundamentals
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to manage multiple clients/projects simultaneously without losing quality of thinking




Nice to have:

Experience with brand positioning or brand architecture work
Familiarity with tools like Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, or similar platforms
A portfolio of strategic work (case studies, decks, campaign write-ups)




What We Offer

Competitive USD salary + performance bonus — above local market rates
Fully remote — work from anywhere in-country
Direct exposure to fast-growing D2C and marketing-led clients
A collaborative, low-ego team that values sharp thinking over hierarchy
Growth path toward Senior Strategist / Strategy Lead

title: Manager, Campaign Management North America
skills: Standardizing Campaign Processes: Implement and enforce a unified set of campaign execution process flows and best practices across all teams and regions, so that every marketing campaign (from planning to launch to post-campaign reporting) follows the same playbook. This involves defining clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), service-level agreements (SLAs) for deliverables, and quality checkpoints. The goal is to ensure every campaign is executed efficiently and “on time, on brand, and on budget”, regardless of which team or region runs it. The Manager will administer quality control over all campaign projects, verifying that essential steps (briefs, reviews, approvals, etc.) are completed for each campaign. They also continuously refine processes to improve speed (“speed to market”) without sacrificing quality or consistency.
Leadership & Team Management: Provide strong leadership, coaching, and direction to 10 Campaign Managers.

Financial Discipline & MDF Management: A critical part of the role is financial oversight of campaign budgets and Marketing Development Funds (MDF). The manager will track all campaign budgets and vendor-provided funds, ensuring budget accuracy, timely utilization, and full compliance with funding requirements. They establish a “zero-tolerance” policy for letting allocated MDF expire unused – which is essential since many vendor funds expire if not utilized within a set timeframe (often 12 months).

Operational Excellence & Capacity Management: Manage the overall campaign production pipeline and capacity planning. With 20+ reports handling numerous simultaneous campaigns, the leader must allocate resources optimally across teams, balancing workloads and adjusting assignments when high-priority projects or “crunch times” arise. They will use tools (like Workfront) and data to monitor each team’s capacity and productivity, ensuring no team is overloaded and that campaigns are delivered per the agreed timeline.

Marketing Technology/Operations team to ensure that systems like Workfront, CRM, and analytics tools are configured to support campaign processes and reporting needs (for instance, integrating Workfront with financial systems like Anaplan or Oracle to sync budget data automatically).

Performance Tracking & ROI Accountability: Ensure that campaign outcomes are measured and communicated in terms of business impact. The Manager will oversee the development of standardized reporting dashboards and processes so that each campaign manager (and their stakeholders) can easily see key metrics like lead volumes, conversion rates through the funnel, pipeline generated, and ROI for their campaigns.
10 years in Marketing Ops, Project Management, or Agency Account Leadership.
5+ years managing large, multi-functional teams (10+ people)
Experience with MDF/Co-op funding and vendor-partner marketing models.

Beyond just using tools, understand API integrations between Work Management (Workfront), CRM (Salesforce/Dynamics), and Marketing Automation (Marketo/HubSpot). Know how data flows from a "Brief" to a "Lead" to a "Financial Claim.
Hands-on experience with enterprise financial software (e.g., Oracle, SAP, or Anaplan) to track MDF allocations, net margins, and cost recovery.
Technical understanding of multi-touch attribution (MTA) to ensure the ROI reported to vendors and leadership is accurate and defensible.
Experience managing Internationalization (i18n) and Localization (l10n) workflows is a huge plus. Know how a campaign flow changes when moving from North America to EMEA or LATAM.
Experience with Marketing Development Funds (MDF) "push back" on vendors regarding proof-of-performance requirements or negotiate better funding terms based on the ROI data they’ve collected.
The ideal candidate has a proven framework for triage—deciding which campaigns get resources when capacity is peaked.

description:
About the job

About the Company:

Wayfinder Agency is the #1 digital marketing agency for tabletop game companies, a fully remote team of marketers, media buyers, and creatives who help incredible games reach players around the world. Our campaigns have generated millions in Kickstarter pledges and eCommerce revenue for brands like Ravensburger, Roll20, Paizo, and Pandasaurus. We’re not your typical agency: we move fast, think creatively, and care deeply about performance. We operate with a lean, collaborative culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership, and if you love strategy, data, and working with passionate creative teams, you’ll fit right in. 




About the Role:

We’re hiring a hands-on Senior Designer & Team Lead who will personally produce high-performing static and motion ads for paid digital campaigns every week, while also mentoring and developing a small remote creative team of 3-4 designers. This role is both a working creative seat and a leadership seat: you’ll build the templates, best practices, and workflows the team runs on, stay close to real performance data, and help define how creative gets made at a growing agency. A genuine passion for tabletop games and gaming culture is a major plus.




This role is a Full-Time remote position.




We are looking for a Senior Designer & Team Lead specifically with these requirements:

Demonstrated ability to personally produce high-performing static and simple motion ads for paid digital campaigns, with speed and consistency.
Strong portfolio of direct-response ad creative, ideally showing work built from client-provided assets (performance ads matter more than brand campaigns).
Experience developing creative that drives performance metrics such as CTR, ROAS, conversions, and customer acquisition.
Experience mentoring or managing designers in a remote setting, giving effective creative feedback, and improving team processes.
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and related design tools, with an efficient, template-smart workflow.
Highly self-directed, with strong communication and organizational skills and the confidence to own your workload in a fully remote environment.
Strong English speaking and writing skills.




Nice to Haves:

A genuine personal interest in tabletop gaming. 
Familiarity with gaming culture more broadly, including Kickstarter launches, conventions, and the communities around them.
Experience designing for niche or enthusiast audiences.
Creative writing abilities to take general concepts and add compelling copy




Your responsibility will include (but not limited to):

Personally design and produce static and simple motion ad-creative for paid social and digital platforms, working from account manager briefs and client-provided assets (our account managers own both the brief and the ad copy, so you can focus entirely on visual craft and execution).
Deliver work reliably on quick timelines that support ongoing creative testing and iteration.
Develop and document creative best practices, design standards, templates, and workflows that make the whole team faster and more consistent.
Lead, mentor, and develop a small remote creative team of 3-4 designers: assign work, balance bandwidth, give constructive design feedback, and support each designer’s professional growth.
Review team deliverables for quality, brand alignment, and performance potential.
Collaborate closely with account management, media buying, and leadership to keep creative aligned with campaign goals and performance objectives.
Communicate proactively with leadership regarding project status, resourcing needs, risks, and opportunities.
Stay current on paid social creative best practices, platform requirements, and trends within gaming and tabletop communities.




Growth Opportunities/Perks:

Opportunity to grow and develop the creative team as the agency scales.
Fully remote work environment.
A chance to define how creative gets made at a growing agency.
Direct exposure to a fast-moving, performance-driven creative team.




You’re a Great Fit for This Role If…

 ✅ You know what high-performing paid social creative looks like and can produce it yourself.

 ✅ You care about measurable outcomes such as CTR, conversions, and ROAS-not just visual quality.

 ✅ You work quickly, stay organized, and can turn limited client-provided assets into effective ads.

 ✅ You enjoy mentoring designers, giving clear feedback, and helping a creative team improve.

 ✅ You communicate proactively and thrive in a fast-moving, remote agency environment.




Our hiring process is made up of four parts, so please be aware that you will need to dedicate time for a questionnaire, a video, and two 1-on-1 interviews.




Thank you for taking the time to consider this position. We look forward to hearing from you soon!

About the job

Recruitment Marketing Specialist:




Job Type: Full-time




Location: Remote




Job Summary:

Join our team as a Recruitment Marketing Specialist and play a pivotal role in driving talent acquisition through innovative marketing strategies. You will spearhead the planning, execution, and analysis of recruitment marketing campaigns, ensuring our initiatives attract top talent and deliver measurable impact. This is a dynamic opportunity to leverage your expertise in recruitment marketing and project management within a collaborative, fully remote environment.




Key Responsibilities:




Own and maintain the supply marketing team’s projects, keeping all initiatives organized, prioritized, and up to date.
Coordinate marketing projects from inception to execution, aligning stakeholders on deliverables and timelines throughout the process.
Manage the seamless production and delivery of both organic and paid content across acquisition channels.
Oversee the marketing content pipeline, working closely with content creators to ensure timely and quality output.
Track, analyze, and report on the performance of marketing campaigns across paid ads, job boards, social media, email, and other platforms.
Surface actionable insights from campaign and channel data, providing clear recommendations to optimize performance and achieve recruitment goals.
Champion effective communication across teams, ensuring alignment and transparency in all project stages.







Required Skills and Qualifications:




Proven experience in recruitment marketing, employer branding, or talent acquisition marketing roles.
Strong project management skills with a history of coordinating multiple complex initiatives simultaneously.
Demonstrated expertise in campaign performance monitoring and data-driven optimization.
Exceptional written and verbal communication abilities, with an emphasis on clarity and stakeholder alignment.
Experience managing content calendars and collaborating with cross-functional teams including content creators and recruiters.
Proficiency with analytics tools and platforms such as Google Analytics, applicant tracking systems, and marketing dashboards.
Detail-oriented, highly organized, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, remote team environment.







Preferred Qualifications:




Background in B2B or high-growth technology environments.
Familiarity with paid advertising for recruitment (e.g., job board ads, programmatic platforms).
Experience with employer branding initiatives and creative recruitment campaigns.

title: Senior Email Marketer, Retention
skills: Own and update the email and SMS campaign calendar, filling out upcoming months and absorbing last-minute shifts from product launches without missing a beat.
Manage the full campaign lifecycle across copywriting, design, QA, and deployment (the team sends daily, so this role focuses on campaigns rather than automated flows).

Solid deliverability fundamentals, sharp project management, and meticulous QA and attention to detail.
Strong English copywriting and creative ability, plus the flexibility to stay calm when the calendar shifts.
Asana experience, since the team relies on it heavily for project management.
Hands-on experience combining Klaviyo, Postscript, and Shopify in one stack.
Competitive USD salary.
100% remote work.
description:
About the job

Location: Mexico, Colombia, Brazil, and Argentina




About Proppel

Proppel is a recruitment agency connecting top talent across the US, Canada, and Latin America with opportunities at some of the most exciting companies in the world.




Whether you are looking for your next role or the right move to advance your career, we will make it happen. 




What we're looking for 

Join a fast-growing, female-founded US-based DTC intimates and apparel brand that generates over $200M in annual revenue with a team of around 100 people. Since launching in 2018, the company has built a category-leading retention program where email and SMS are treated as a core, profitable growth channel, not an afterthought. This is a true ownership role for a senior operator who wants to run the full campaign lifecycle end-to-end.




What You’ll Be Doing

Own and update the email and SMS campaign calendar, filling out upcoming months and absorbing last-minute shifts from product launches without missing a beat.
Manage the full campaign lifecycle across copywriting, design, QA, and deployment (the team sends daily, so this role focuses on campaigns rather than automated flows).
Build and run segmentation strategy (RFM, product affinity, cohort behavior) alongside structured A/B and multivariate tests.
Lead execution of product launches and major promotional moments (like BFCM) across email and SMS.
Report on performance to leadership and mentor junior and mid-level team members as the retention function grows.




Requirements

6+ years in retention, lifecycle, or CRM marketing focused on email and SMS (4+ years considered if coming from a similarly large brand).
Extensive, advanced Klaviyo experience (non-negotiable), plus Postscript or a similar SMS platform.
Experience at a mid-to-large Shopify organization, ideally with a headless setup that adds complexity to Klaviyo.
Strong analytics and segmentation skills, with a clear test-and-learn methodology.
Solid deliverability fundamentals, sharp project management, and meticulous QA and attention to detail.
Strong English copywriting and creative ability, plus the flexibility to stay calm when the calendar shifts.




Nice to Have

Asana experience, since the team relies on it heavily for project management.
Hands-on experience combining Klaviyo, Postscript, and Shopify in one stack.




Benefits

Competitive USD salary.
100% remote work.




Notes:

*You are applying to work with an international company. Make sure your CV is in English, otherwise your application can't be considered.

*We consider candidates from all around Mexico, Colombia, Brazil, and Argentina.

*If you don't have a formal portfolio, please share a Drive with various samples of your work.

*Please note this is a contractor position: As a contractor, you are responsible most of the time for managing your own contributions to social security, health insurance, and any applicable taxes or obligations in your country of residence. This can vary depending on the client. For contractor FAQs, please visit our website.

About the job

Visit.org is looking for a passionate and experienced Marketing Creative Lead to join our remote team. The Creative Lead will own our visual identity and creative output, developing campaigns and assets that make Visit.org stand out in the CSR and employee engagement market. This is a senior, hands-on role for a designer who can both set creative direction and execute at a high standard across digital, video, and event formats. The right candidate will have an entrepreneurial spirit, a deep passion for our mission, and the energy and discipline to thrive as a builder in a startup tech environment.

Please note: This is a remote, Mexico-based 40 hr/week contract position that requires working hours from 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST

What Motivates Us

There is room for everyone! We empower each other to innovate and create processes that use technology to generate meaningful, lasting change. We enjoy the challenge of finding solutions to problems that are not a way around it but through it. We're driven by the opportunity to help enterprises and their employees around the world to contribute to their communities.

When You Join the Team


You'll join a movement from the ground floor and a team of purpose-driven people with a strong sense of responsibility, ownership, and pride that we're building this thing together. 
You'll combine passion, purpose, and a paycheck—Visit.org team members get out of bed every day knowing their work is meaningful and has a tangible impact on individuals and communities around the world


About Visit.org:

Visit.org is a women-led Certified B Corporation that designs and delivers full-scale volunteering programs for global companies, with volunteering experiences built with vetted nonprofit partners and rooted in real community needs in 100+ countries and 40+ languages. Trusted by teams at companies like Amazon, Colgate, Paramount, and Cisco, Visit.org acts as an extension of lean CSR teams to run global volunteering that employees love and nonprofits trust.

Develop creative concepts and visual campaigns for events, social media, email, website, sales initiatives, and product launches
Evolve and maintain Visit.org's visual identity, ensuring consistency and a premium brand experience across every customer touchpoint

Collaborate with marketing, sales, product, and executive leadership to translate business goals into compelling creative solutions
Bring fresh ideas, design trends, AI-powered creative workflows, and new storytelling approaches that help Visit.org stand out in the CSR and employee engagement market


Requirements


4 to 7 years of experience in graphic design, brand design, or creative roles, with a track record of leading creative work from concept through delivery
Strong portfolio demonstrating campaign-level creative work across digital marketing, social media, presentations, and video (portfolio required with application)
Fluent professional English, written and spoken; this role works daily with a US-based team and creates content for US-market audiences
Expert proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects) and modern design tools such as Figma and Canva
Experience building and maintaining brand systems, including visual identity guidelines, templates, and asset libraries that scale across teams
Strong video editing and motion design skills, with experience producing content for social, marketing, and events
Experience adopting AI-powered creative tools and workflows to increase output quality and speed

description:
About the job

Este es un puesto de trabajo remoto.

Buenas,

Somos Ekalon.

Si estás leyendo esto, probablemente tienes experiencia en paid media.

Vamos a explicarte qué buscamos exactamente, porque esta no es una posición estándar.

Lo primero que debes saber sobre Ekalon y cómo trabajamos

En Ekalon trabajamos para que profesionales de LATAM accedan a mejores oportunidades laborales en empresas internacionales, de forma remota.

Somos un equipo de más de 30 personas distribuidas en distintos países.

Llevamos años trabajando en remoto, con sistemas y herramientas (como Zoho y otros sistemas internos) que nos permiten tener claridad total sobre qué hay que hacer, cómo hacerlo y qué se espera de cada persona.

Aquí no hay jefes encima tuyo.

Pero sí hay algo más importante:

responsabilidad, autonomía y foco en resultados.

Estamos en crecimiento, y cada persona que entra tiene impacto directo en el negocio.

Si eres de los que quiere aportar, crecer y trabajar con libertad real, esta posición te va a gustar.

Importante

Estamos buscando a alguien que sume, que aporte y con quien dé gusto trabajar.

Nos tomamos muy en serio los valores de la empresa.

No están para decorar, están para construir un equipo de alto rendimiento.

Valores base:

1- Humildad: Para aceptar que siempre hay algo que no sabemos y en lo que podemos mejorar.

2- Hambre: Para tener ganas de ser mejores personas y profesionales con esfuerzo y dedicación.

3- Empatía: Para entender y ayudar a nuestros compañeros

Valores medulares:

1- Actitud ganadora: Entusiasmo, optimismo y resolutivo

2- Implicados: Conseguimos la máxima calidad y responsabilidad en nuestro trabajo = entregamos tareas en tiempo y forma

3- Trabajamos en equipo: hacemos equipo, empatizamos con el equipo

4- Nos gusta nuestro trabajo: Creemos una empresa de la que nos sintamos orgullosos, nos guste trabajar en ella y que sume y no reste en nuestra vida personal

5- Transparencia: comunicación, confianza en poder hablarlo todo aunque no nos guste lo que se vaya a decir

6- Cuidemos de Ekalon y Ekalon cuidará de nosotros

Si esto no resuena contigo, esta posición no es para ti.

El rol

No es solo un rol de ejecución.

Vas a crear y gestionar campañas, pero lo importante es tu capacidad de tomar decisiones y generar resultados.

Es un rol de responsabilidad sobre la adquisición de clientes.

Tu objetivo será hacer crecer el negocio a través de campañas publicitarias.

Objetivo del rol

Escalar la captación de clientes en mercados europeos (España, Italia, Francia y Andorra) de forma rentable, optimizando CAC y maximizando el ROAS.

Qué harás


Definir la estrategia de adquisición de clientes 
Crear, gestionar y optimizar campañas en Meta Ads y Google Ads 
Analizar métricas clave (CAC, ROAS, CPL, conversión) 
Tomar decisiones basadas en datos 
Detectar oportunidades reales de crecimiento 
Proponer nuevas ideas, tests y enfoques 
Coordinar mejoras en el funnel (no solo campañas) 
Reportar resultados con claridad 


Nivel esperado en este rol

Esperamos que hayas trabajado con métricas de negocio como CAC, ROAS o volumen de adquisición, y que entiendas cómo tus decisiones impactan directamente en resultados.

Este no es solo un rol de ejecución.

Buscamos a alguien que piense, ejecute y se haga responsable del resultado.

Si tu experiencia se limita a gestionar campañas sin responsabilidad sobre estos resultados, este rol no es para ti.

Con qué recursos contarás

Formarás parte de un equipo donde podrás apoyarte en distintos perfiles para mejorar el rendimiento de campañas:


2 Diseñadores 
1 Especialista en Analítica Web 
1 Programador Web

About the job

About The Job

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Business Analyst / Product Owner to join our team. The ideal candidate will work closely with scrum teams, product stakeholders, and delivery managers to ensure business requirements are well-defined, backlogs are properly maintained, and delivery runs smoothly. This role requires a blend of analytical skills, strong communication, and the ability to operate independently across BA/PO, and at times very light Scrum Master responsibilities. This is a technically oriented BA role. Rather than standard UI-facing BA work, the focus is on non-UI and systems integration efforts, including interfaces between clinical and enterprise systems. Candidates do not need to be deeply technical engineers, but they should be comfortable working with integration concepts, data flows, and technical stakeholders; a traditional BA without this background may find the role challenging.

Key Responsibilities


Write clear and detailed user stories and acceptance criteria based on stakeholder needs and business goals, and communicate requirements effectively in a fast-paced Agile environment.
Define and document requirements for non-UI and integration-focused work, including system-to-system interfaces, data exchange, and API-based (point-to-point) integrations.

Keep documentation organized and current in compliance with the Software Development Life Cycle.
Lead requirement gathering workshops with key business stakeholders and application users, covering business processes, workflows, business and technical requirements, legacy systems, and application mapping.
Work with engineering to continuously build, refine, and prioritize project team backlogs.

Bachelor's Degree in a life science, computer science, technology, mathematics, engineering, or a related discipline.
2+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Analyst, Business Analyst, Technical Analyst, or Associate Product Manager in a software or technically oriented business environment.

description:
About the job

About the Team

Our New Verticals Strategy & Operations team is re-inventing the way consumers think about grocery, convenience, alcohol and retail delivery through both our first-party and third-party operations businesses. DashMart is our first-party offering which serves as a fulfillment platform for DoorDash customers when they need essential items in a hurry – including groceries, household essentials, local favorites and so much more. We have sites all over the country and are expanding the selection we carry and services we offer our customers today!

About the Role

We are hiring a Delivery Team Lead to join the DashMart Supply Chain team, focused on overseeing inbound deliveries and driving strong on-time performance across our vendor network. You will lead and manage a 4-5 person team responsible for vendor outreach, real-time delivery updates, and cross-functional coordination between our sites and vendors. You will build a deep understanding of vendor performance and internal workflows and apply that knowledge to strengthen vendor accountability, improve team processes, and highlight key drivers of on-time delivery degradation.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Lead on-time delivery initiatives – Own OTD reporting and drive measurable improvement in on-time delivery for our top vendors, developing longer-term approaches to sustainably improve performance
Manage and mentor a team of Delivery Specialists – Develop talent, set team goals, and coach team members to strong execution
Strengthen vendor partnerships – Elevate vendor accountability and collaboration to drive consistent on-time performance and reduce delivery variability
Build and improve operations – Identify, refine and scale processes for our team's daily operations. Identify systemic root causes and design scalable process improvements across our network.
Collaborate cross-functionally – Work closely with local operations, vendor management, demand planning, and inventory management to align on goals and execute initiatives
Analyze – Use data to guide decisions at both the strategic and operational levels, leveraging SQL, dashboards, and google sheets


We're excited about you because…


You have an ownership mindset: You take responsibility for outcomes, balancing attention to detail with the ability to step back and identify broader trends and opportunities.
You're analytical: You use data to inform decisions, challenge assumptions, and drive clarity.
You're a problem solver: You have a talent for synthesizing complex problems and can independently translate high level goals into actionable plans for your team.
You're an effective communicator: You seamlessly relay information between external partners and internal teams, ensuring alignment, clear expectations, and end-to-end execution.


Qualifications


3+ years of experience in supply chain, operations or a related field, including experience managing two or more direct reports 
Strong experience communicating with and managing external vendors or partners
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
